Destination image organization

Use this folder for destination-page images only.

Structure:

- honduras/
- turquia/
- costa-rica/
- malta/

Inside each destination folder, every subfolder corresponds to a visual section/div in that destination proposal page.

Package plan photos:

- paquete-economico/01.jpg
- paquete-confort/01.jpg
- paquete-lujo/01.jpg

These images feed the package comparison article in the destination planner section. If a package image is missing, the website falls back to the default remote image.

Upload gallery images as:

- 01.jpg
- 02.jpg
- 03.jpg
- 04.jpg

The website checks these local files first. If an image is missing, it falls back to the remote placeholder image already configured in the code.

Do not rename the route pages from /destinos. This folder is only for image assets.
